AI Overview
You can play the original Halo: Combat Evolved directly in a web browser without installing any software. 
Croma
 +1
Key Features of the Browser Version
Full Campaign & Co-op: Play the entire single-player campaign, including split-screen co-op on a single computer using a mix of controllers or mouse and keyboard.
128-Player Multiplayer: Supports massive online multiplayer lobbies (well above the original 16-player limit) by sharing an invite link with friends.
Performance: Runs smoothly on desktop browsers (working best on Chromium-based browsers) at around 70 to 120 FPS depending on your hardware.
Controls: Supports full mouse and keyboard control as well as gamepads.
Storage: Game saves are tied directly to your browser cookies/data, meaning clearing your browsing data will erase your saved progress. 
YouTube
·Harto Method
 +4
Important Notes
Unofficial Project: Created by developer Mitchell Hynes using reverse-engineered code and decompilations of the 2001 Xbox original, meaning availability can be subject to publisher takedowns.
Device Limits: While it loads on various devices, the developer recommends playing on a desktop PC, as performance on mobile phones or tablets can be poor.
